main.description: A cooperative/ESS node's self-asserted profile record. One per member repo -- 'Eleanor's' profile, as this namespace understands it, is the union of every included member's own profile record, not a single converged statement. See ESS_MESH_SPEC.md sections 3.3 and 3.9.

category.description: Governance tier. Must match tools/sbci/sbci/ess_source.py's CATEGORY_WEIGHTS keys exactly -- this is the shared vocabulary the SBCI pipeline's SCED weighting reads from a self-asserted field instead of guessing at from outside.

neighborhood.description: Coarse location, safe for the public tier (ESS_MESH_SPEC.md 3.5) -- not a street address.

governanceEligible.description: Self-asserted claim of governance-eligible standing (ESS_MESH_SPEC.md 3.7.2). Not authoritative on its own -- a reader checking actual standing should verify against the namespace's governance collection (network.essmesh.governance.signal / .proposal history), not trust this field alone. Present for quick display, not as the source of truth.
